verdicts.reason: A is a clean vertical restack (logo and badge on top, headline, then the circle with the shoe, then the subline), with clear hierarchy and good fidelity. It has small flaws: the circle and shoe crowd the 'Full review inside.' line, the badge is nudged away from the right edge, and the logo is small. B is broken: the white headline sits right on top of the lime circle and the shoe image, so it is barely readable; the wordmark collides with the circle; the 'NEW VIDEO' badge is moved below the subline as if it were a CTA; and the bottom ~45% of the canvas is empty.
